title: Quantum Information and Computation
text:
0.1 Scope
These are lecture notes for Quantum Information and Computation (third-semester elective, Master in Physics of Data, University of Padova). At the time of writing the professor has not yet distributed lecture slides; this book is therefore a structural skeleton — chapter titles and a suggested organisation that will be filled in as the course progresses.
The skeleton follows the standard Nielsen–Chuang curriculum:
Every chapter is currently a stub with a suggested table of contents; it will be expanded once the course delivers content.

title: Quantum Information and Computation
text:
Chapter 1 — single-qubit systems, Bloch sphere, and single-qubit gates.
Chapter 2 — multi-qubit systems, entanglement, and Bell states.
Chapter 3 — quantum circuits and universal gate sets.
Chapter 4 — quantum algorithms (Deutsch–Jozsa, Grover, Shor).
Chapter 5 — quantum error correction.
Chapter 6 — quantum information theory (von Neumann entropy, quantum channels).

title: Quantum Information and Computation
text:
0.2 Sources (planned)
Primary reference: Nielsen & Chuang, Quantum Computation and Quantum Information, 10th anniversary ed., Cambridge (2010). Secondary: Benenti, Casati & Strini, Principles of Quantum Computation and Information, World Scientific (2004).

title: 2  Qubits and single-qubit operations
text:
Postulates of quantum mechanics for a two-level system.
The Bloch sphere and geometric visualisation.
Pauli operators, Hadamard, phase, and rotation gates.
Measurement in a general basis; projective vs POVM.
Physical implementations: superconducting transmon, ion trap, neutral atom (link to 2sem IQH notes).
